copyLinkCounts.rule: lib, home copies and harness node_modules are copied with dereference:true and asserted to contain zero symlinks, so ESM cannot traverse a link out of the scratch root.

homePreflight.rule: Every regular file in the pristine home must have nlink === 1 before any read/copy; every symlink must resolve inside the home root.

symlinkCheck.rule: Every symlink in the pristine home and in each scratch copy is resolved with realpath.native (lstat/readdir withFileTypes, never following) and must stay inside its own root by filesystem identity; dangling links and out-of-root links fail the run. The formal DSH_HOME, TMPDIR, --out and scratch paths use realpath-style resolution: a resolved stack plus a pending component queue, symlink targets prepended, `..` popping the resolved stack, 40-hop and repeated-link loop guards, missing final component allowed. Containment is decided by lstat dev:ino identities of the resolved path and its ancestors (string prefix is only a fast path), on both sides where applicable. An existing --out must be a regular file with nlink === 1 and a dev/ino distinct from both protected roots and their ancestors (metadata only; no production file contents are read). --runtime and every runtime file read or executed (CLI and all manifests) are rejected if related to either protected root, must have nlink === 1 and must resolve inside the runtime; scratch is created from the resolved TMPDIR, never the raw string; every spawned child explicitly receives TMPDIR/TEMP/TMP inside the scratch (ACP child also receives HOME = its own home copy).

threshold.metric: spawn -> session/new, steady-state paired on-off median

method.arms: on (bundle selected), off (bundle deselected in a fresh copy, package still installed), on2 (second fresh copy identical to on)
method.perRound: every arm gets a brand-new copy of the pristine home; copying time is excluded; arm order rotates on-off-on2 / off-on2-on / on2-on-off
method.timers: process.hrtime-equivalent performance.now() from just before spawn to the initialize response and to the session/new response; both are asserted successful
method.modelIsolation: loopback SSE provider via --patch, one end_turn text response with no tool_use. Provider arrival timestamps (recorded before body drain) are compared against the session/new completion instant: requestsInsideTimedWindow must be 0 over the whole [spawn, session/new] interval, and requestsAfterTimer must be >=1 after an UNTIMED prompt.
method.assertions: initialize/session/new/prompt success, timestamp-based request-window check, overlay request observed, bundle selected/deselected in each copy, seeded records reach source validation (not index-shape), every symlink in the pristine home and each copy resolves inside its own root, resolved formal home and resolved TMPDIR/scratch/--out outside protected directories, existing --out regular with nlink===1 and no protected dev/ino
method.quantiles: linear interpolation over per-round values; paired differences are computed per round before their median/p25/p75
method.exclusion: host cold start (~1.3-1.5 s), closed-loop self-evolution CPU, consumer-session GC and all attribution probes are separate and are never added to the ACP delta

decision.metric: spawn -> session/new, steady-state paired on-off median

attribution.method: Separate fresh-process probes: entry module graph (node:module registerHooks, apply() asserted), openSharedExperience cold then hot on a fresh root, published.json readSharedIndex + evaluateSharedRecord on seeded roots with 0/5/50 records. Probes import a byte copy of the installed bundle lib with a temp node_modules assembled from the resolved host packages (host and profile stores); no pristine-home file is written. Measures only what each note says; nothing here is summed into the ACP arm delta.

moduleLoad.reference: R13 (docs/performance/session-startup-and-experience-growth-20261117.md) reported acp 11.98 ms / 456,178 bytes / 25 modules; that number was NOT re-measured in this run.

sharedExperience.note: measures openSharedExperience() only (schema create/PRAGMA/read); not collector subscribe, tool registration or host composition
